julia: Heads-up — while profiling Mixtral+LLama blend workloads I hit a weird perf swing tied to tokenizer byte-fallback + EOS placement. p99 token-step latency jumps ~3x when prompts contain non-UTF8 sequences that trigger byte-fallback.

samir: ugh. any logs or a repro? :eyes:

julia: yes, minimal repro attached below. Using mixtral-8x and llama-13b, seq_len=1024. baseline (no byte-fallback tokens): step p99 ~42ms. with byte-fallback snippet in system prompt: step p99 ~125ms, KV cache hit ratio drops from 0.98 to 0.63.

mike: can you paste the kernel-picker trace? wondering if we’re swapping to a slower attention kernel on tokenization boundary.

julia: trace snippet: ```
[kernel_picker] model=mixtral-8x seq=1024 tokens_encoding=UTF8 -> kernel=fast_attn_v3
[kernel_picker] model=mixtral-8x seq=12 tokens_encoding=BYTES -> kernel=byte_safe_attn
[exec] kv_store: flush_on_kernel_swap=true -> cleared 4.8MB cache
[metrics] kv_hit_ratio=0.62, token_step_ms=122
```

tara: that flush_on_kernel_swap flag should only trigger when layout changes (kv dims/heads mismatch), but looks like we treat encoding change as layout-change.

samir: aha. tokenizer encoding affecting kernel selection is over-broad. We map encoding->kernel table where BYTES implies fallback kernel; but layout is the same. we accidentally set layout_changed=true when encoding_changed.

mike: so every time a prompt contains a 1-2 byte fallback token at batch boundaries we cause cache eviction -> thrash. explains p99.

julia: exact. also saw EOS handling differences: some chat templates append explicit <|endoftext|> which the tokenizer maps to special tokens in UTF8, but if preceding non-utf8 bytes exist the tokenizer returns mixed encodings and our kernel switch triggers mid-generation.

tara: quick mitigation: change kernel_picker to compare structural layout (heads, kv_dim, dtype) not encoding flags. keep encoding fallback only as runtime shim, not kernel_switch trigger.

samir: agreed. simple patch idea: in kernel_picker: replace: ```if encoding_changed: layout_changed = true``` with ```if encoding_changed and (heads_changed or kvdim_changed or dtype_changed): layout_changed = true```

mike: add unit test for mixed-encoding prompt + chat templates. Also add a perf regression test that asserts kv_cache_retention >= 0.9 for our synthetic mixed prompts.

julia: did a quick local patch — reran repro: p99 drops back to 46ms, kv_hit_ratio 0.97. micro-bench diff attached in gist: https://internal/gists/1782/mixtral-bytefix

infra-bot: CI triggered for branch fix/avoid-encoding-kernel-swap — 3 jobs queued

tara: rolling to canary tomorrow if CI green. plan: canary on dedicated pool with mixtral-8x and llama-13b traffic (10% for 2h), monitor kv_hit_ratio and p99.

mike: schedule an alert rule for kv_hit_ratio < 0.85 during rollout. also add a log counter for how often encoding change causes kernel selection decision.

samir: followup: evaluate RoPE scaling edge-case — when RoPE scaling is applied (mixtral quantized run) combined with byte-fallback we saw slight accuracy diffs. might need to keep kernel variant pinned per model+rope_mode.

julia: noted. will open a follow-up issue to validate rope-scalers across kernels: ISSUE-4123.

mike: one more: some downstream customers send chat templates with trailing invisible control chars. Recommend we add optional prompt-sanitizer to devex templates to normalize to NFC and strip control ranges before tokenization. low-risk opt-in.

tara: agree. we'll draft a small middleware. can we push fix + tests today?

julia: yes. PR up in 30m. ping me if you want to review: @samir @mike. :shipit:

deploy-bot: deploy queued: refs/heads/fix/avoid-encoding-kernel-swap -> staging at 1782349950
